ambiguities.detail: next.config.ts async rewrites() mixes literal and computed sources: computed from imported ./pagesAndRewritePaths (orgUserRoutePath, orgUserTypeRoutePath), i18n locales.join('|'), and env vars (ORGANIZATIONS_ENABLED, NEXT_PUBLIC_SINGLE_ORG_SLUG). Config throws without NEXTAUTH_SECRET/CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY — cannot even be evaluated without env. Literals R; computed U.
Same URL may exist in both routers. Next's pages-wins-over-app rule is documented convention (I here); conflicts not checked file-by-file.
